The act of preparing for the exchange is a way of asserting control over your environment, a form of 'self-preservation' during the dissociation. While the experience is terrifying, it is also a necessary step for your mental well-being. I recommend continuing to communicate with your wife as clearly and calmly as possible, as your voice is your most direct form of expression.
